name: Anchor
body:
School abjuration; Level sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a small bit of iron and a piece of string)

EFFECT

Range 1 ship
Area see text
Duration 2 hours/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell maintains a ship’s position against currents, holding ships weighing up to 10 tons per caster level.
